LanguageData.LP_Ability_DivinePreach.label: miracle preaching
LanguageData.LP_Ability_DivinePreach.description: Preach to the other with miracles as proof, persuading them to convert to the speaker's culture. Twice as effective as vanilla "convert"; costs an extra 5 patron deity divine favor (unusable if there isn't enough). Same cooldown as vanilla convert (3 days).
LanguageData.LP_Ability_DivinePreach.comps.CompAbilit: {INITIATOR_labelShort}'s preaching failed to convince {RECIPIENT_labelShort}. {RECIPIENT_labelShort} is a bit annoyed, but their certainty fell from {CERTAINTYBEFORE} to {CERTAINTYAFTER}.
{INITIATOR_labelShort} preached with miracles, and {RECIPIENT_labelShort} converted to {IDEO}.
